urls.title: URLs to watch
urls.description: Any pages to monitor for content changes. Optional per-URL CSS selector or label: {"url": "...", "selector": "#main"}. Not specialized for SaaS pricing cards — use Pricing Page Change Monitor for that.

cssSelector.title: CSS selector (optional)
cssSelector.description: Limit the watched region to this CSS selector, e.g. main, #content, article. Per-URL selector overrides this. Leave empty to watch visible text of the whole page.

contentMode.title: Content mode
contentMode.description: text extracts visible text lines (default). json treats the response as JSON and flattens key paths for diffing (useful for APIs). html_text is an alias of text.

renderMode.title: Page rendering
renderMode.description: auto uses HTTP first and falls back to a headless browser when the page looks empty or blocked. http never uses a browser. browser always renders with Chromium.

includeUnchanged.title: Output a row for unchanged pages
includeUnchanged.description: When on, pages without changes get one no_change row so every run shows what was checked. Turn off to output only real changes.

ignoreTextPatterns.title: Ignore text matching (regex)
ignoreTextPatterns.description: Lines matching these regexes are ignored when comparing (timestamps, counters, ads).

maxDiffLines.title: Max added/removed lines in output
maxDiffLines.description: Cap how many added/removed lines are included per change row.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (optional)
webhookUrl.description: If set, the Actor POSTs one JSON payload with all detected changes after the run (only when something changed). Works with Slack and Discord incoming webhooks.

webhookHeaders.title: Webhook headers (optional)
webhookHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers to send with the webhook, for example an Authorization header.

webhookOnBaseline.title: Send webhook for first-run baselines
webhookOnBaseline.description: By default the first run of a URL only saves a baseline and does not notify. Turn on to also send baseline rows to the webhook.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store in your account where page snapshots are kept between runs. Letters, digits and hyphens only.

maxConcurrency.title: Max parallel pages
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages to check at the same time. Keep it low (1-3) on small memory.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most pages load without a proxy. Use Apify Proxy only if a site blocks the default IPs.
